## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards (PEP8, Black, Ruff, isort).
- [ ] I have added full type hints and Google-style docstrings.
- [ ] I have added tests under `tests/` that prove my fix is effective or feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README accordingly.
